summary: Warehouse clearance without payment of duty; 27 cases missing from bonded warehouse; 264 cases found outside but within factory premises; heavy rains cited as reason for moving goods outside warehouse under superintendent permission; Section 71 violation vs Section 15 compliance; confiscation vs redemption; duty demand confirmed with interest; standard: reasonable cause for shifting goods vs procedural breach; penalty imposition reviewed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed with modification; duty demand on missing 27 cases sustained; confiscation of 264 cases set aside; redemption allowed; penalty reduced.
